content.text: {"rules":[{"jurisdiction":"NJ","level":"state","category":"application_screening_fees","status":"in_force","title":"Residential Rental Property Application Fee Limitation","requirement":"A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50. The fee shall be adjusted annually by the Director of the Division of Consumer Affairs in direct proportion to the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over a 12-month period ending October 31 of the previous year, with adjustment effective January 1 of each following calendar year.
